{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
  SELECT component_id, per_assembly_qty, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bill_of_materials
  WHERE assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number='FR-M63S-38')
    AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty, bom.lvl+1
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom ON b.assembly_id = bom.component_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT SUM(bom.per_assembly_qty) AS qty
FROM bom
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2341'"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
prod AS (SELECT product_id, product_number, make_flag FROM product),
-- BOM lines valid on a given date
bom_earlier AS (
  SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
  FROM bill_of_materials
  WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    AND start_date <= DATE '2021-08-10'
    AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-08-10' <= end_date)
),
bom_current AS (
  SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
  FROM bill_of_materials
  WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
    AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
-- recursive expansion for earlier
exp_earlier AS (
  SELECT p.product_id AS root_id, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
  FROM bom_earlier b
  JOIN prod p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-M18S-44'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_id, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
  FROM exp_earlier e
  JOIN bom_earlier b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
),
exp_current AS (
  SELECT p.product_id AS root_id, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
  FROM bom_current b
  JOIN prod p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-M18S-44'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_id, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
  FROM exp_current e
  JOIN bom_current b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
),

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE cur AS (SELECT assembly_id, component_id FROM bill_of_materials WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)), bikes AS (SELECT p.product_id FROM product p JOIN product_subcategory s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id JOIN product_category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Bikes'), walk(root_id, comp_id) AS (SELECT b.product_id, cur.component_id FROM bikes b JOIN cur ON cur.assembly_id = b.product_id UNION SELECT w.root_id, cur.component_id FROM walk w JOIN cur ON cur.assembly_id = w.comp_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.product_number FROM walk w JOIN product cp ON cp.product_id = w.comp_id JOIN product rp ON rp.product_id = w.root_id WHERE cp.product_number = 'SE-T924' ORDER BY rp.product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE tree(root, comp) AS (SELECT p.product_number, b.component_id FROM bill_of_materials b JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-M18S-40','BK-R79Y-42') AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30') UNION SELECT t.root, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.comp WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')), parts AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.root, p.product_number FROM tree t JOIN product p ON p.product_id = t.comp WHERE p.make_flag = false) SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-M18S-40' EXCEPT SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-R79Y-42' ORDER BY product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE tree(root, pid) AS (SELECT p.product_number, p.product_id FROM product p WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-M38S-38','BK-R50R-60') UNION SELECT t.root, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.pid WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')), parts AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.root, pr.product_number FROM tree t JOIN product pr ON pr.product_id = t.pid WHERE pr.make_flag = false AND pr.product_number NOT IN ('BK-M38S-38','BK-R50R-60')) SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-M38S-38' EXCEPT SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-R50R-60' ORDER BY product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE tree(root, component_id) AS ( SELECT p.product_number, b.component_id FROM bill_of_materials b JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46','BK-M18B-52') AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date) UNION SELECT t.root, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date) ), parts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.root, p.product_number FROM tree t JOIN product p ON p.product_id = t.component_id WHERE p.make_flag = false ) SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-T44U-46' EXCEPT SELECT product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-M18B-52' ORDER BY product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE tree(root, component_id) AS ( SELECT p.product_number, b.component_id FROM bill_of_materials b JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46','BK-M18B-52') AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date) UNION SELECT t.root, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date) ) SELECT t.root, COUNT(DISTINCT t.component_id) AS n_all, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.make_flag = false THEN t.component_id END) AS n_parts FROM tree t JOIN product p ON p.product_id = t.component_id GROUP BY t.root"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (SELECT assembly_id, component_id FROM bill_of_materials WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')), tree(root_id, component_id) AS (SELECT p.product_id, b.component_id FROM product p JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-M47B-38','BK-M82S-44') UNION SELECT t.root_id, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id), parts AS (SELECT r.product_number AS root, c.product_number AS part FROM tree t JOIN product r ON r.product_id = t.root_id JOIN product c ON c.product_id = t.component_id WHERE c.make_flag = false) SELECT DISTINCT part AS product_number FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-M47B-38' AND part NOT IN (SELECT part FROM parts WHERE root = 'BK-M82S-44') ORDER BY product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (SELECT assembly_id, component_id FROM bill_of_materials WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')), tree(root_id, component_id) AS (SELECT p.product_id, b.component_id FROM product p JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-M47B-38','BK-M82S-44') UNION SELECT t.root_id, b.component_id FROM tree t JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = t.component_id) SELECT r.product_number AS root, COUNT(DISTINCT c.product_number) FILTER (WHERE c.make_flag = false) AS n_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.product_number) AS n_all FROM tree t JOIN product r ON r.product_id = t.root_id JOIN product c ON c.product_id = t.component_id GROUP BY r.product_number"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE dates(d, sign) AS (SELECT DATE '2025-06-30', 1 UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2021-06-08', -1), root AS (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R38B-62'), target AS (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2341'), expl(d, sign, component_id, qty, depth) AS (SELECT dt.d, dt.sign, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty, 1 FROM dates dt JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM root) AND b.start_date <= dt.d AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR dt.d <= b.end_date) UNION ALL SELECT e.d, e.sign, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty, e.depth + 1 FROM expl e JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = true JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id AND b.start_date <= e.d AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR e.d <= b.end_date) WHERE e.depth < 50) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target) THEN sign * qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS change, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target) AND sign = 1 THEN qty END), 0) AS current_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target) AND sign = -1 THEN qty END), 0) AS earlier_qty FROM expl"}
